description: First-visit discovery overlay — new port, village, landmark, or sea region

Storyline / cutscene is currently active. Top-right chrome shows 'Skip', 'Auto', and 'Dialog History' controls; the rest of the screen is taken over by the cutscene (NPC sprite + speech bubble or background scene). Bot does not need to play story content for now — the dismissal handler skips out via Skip when available, taps confirm on any skip-confirmation dialog, taps any button on a mandatory-choice screen (the user confirmed any button advances the cutscene), and falls back to a safe lower-centre tap for narration screens. Loops until the cutscene chrome clears.
detection: Top-right cutscene chrome — both 'Skip' and 'Dialog History' visible. Both required (conjunction) so settings/auto-sail menus that contain 'Auto' alone don't false-fire.

description: Daily news popup — LINE web content viewer.  The popup has TWO display states: (A) the article-list view used to show 'Main' / 'Daily News' as a title, and (B) after the bot accidentally taps an article link the title bar is replaced by a larger hamburger + back-arrow chrome with NO title text.  Title-based detection ('Main') only catches state A.  Body-content keywords catch BOTH states because the LINE viewer shows the 'Uncharted Waters Origin' site identifier under every article header.  The close button is a small round X icon hanging OUTSIDE the dialog at its top-right edge — hard to see (low contrast against background, partially overlapping the underlying perk/event popup's 'Attendance' header text).  Do NOT use the screen-corner fallback or any X-shaped icon found by OCR; both would hit the wrong popup.
detection: 'Uncharted Waters Origin' site label visible in popup body (matches both list-view and article-view).  Legacy 'Main' title only matched the list view.

description: Daily login reward popup

Monthly attendance event popup — shows calendar/progress.  Close X is a white X glyph inside the dark header bar at the top-right corner of the screen (well above and right of the daily-news popup's X, which can stack on top).

Perk event popup — shows perk rewards/progress; often appears together with the attendance popup as the same modal (Perk/Event tabs at the top).  Close X is a white X glyph inside the dark header bar at the top-right corner of the screen.
detection: 'Perk Event' or 'Perk' text visible in popup

description: Server-wide announcement popup
detection: 'Announcement' or 'Notice' text in a centered modal

description: Level-up or skill-up notification overlay

Android-style connection unstable warning — forces a game reload.  Critical to detect: when this fires undetected the bot keeps running on stale perception while the game has restarted underneath, leading to long sea_cinematic waits and timeouts (observed in May-1 16:43 run).  Three-keyword conjunction is specific enough not to false-fire on harbor / market 'notice' dialogs.

Another player requests a union (combat) engagement.  Dialog is centered modal — Union main view also contains 'Union' and 'Request' words in its title bar and left-strip menu, so structural.text_zone restricts the match to the central dialog area only.
Confirmation raised by pressing Back with goods staged — the game says 'Moving to another menu will empty the cart. Continue?' with Cancel / Ok. Answering Ok completes the exit we asked for.
detection: dialog warning that leaving will empty the staged cart

description: Supply exhausted warning dialog — appears at sea
detection: supply exhausted / out of supply dialog visible

description: Fleet destruction recovery screen. Two options: 'Quick Revive' (costs blue gems, revives in place — only use if carrying extremely high value cargo) and 'Port Return' (free, returns to nearest port with damaged ships, 0 crew, some cargo loss). Default action is always Port Return by tapping the right card at approximately (1800, 120). If a confirmation OK appears, dismiss it. Bot should NEVER choose Quick Revive unless a future high-value-cargo flag is set.
detection: Quick Revive + Port Return + Revive in current location + Return to the nearest city + Naval Protection + Enemy Strike

description: A language/expertise info popup appeared when the bot tapped near the language tile in the lower-left area of the market screen. The popup shows Language and Expertise level effects. Bot must dismiss it by tapping the centred OK button first, then find and tap the Purchase button located at the lower-right of the market screen. Bot was incorrectly identifying flow as market_sell; correct flow is market_purchase.
detection: Language LV Effect + Expertise LV Effect + Languages Known + Purchasing LV + Sales LV + Portuguese

description: When inside Harbor > Supply, the bot accidentally tapped the manual supply option which opens a per-item supply dialog (Water/Food/Material/Ammo). This should be dismissed via the X button (top-right of the dialog, approx 1538,178 in original coords) and then Auto Supply should be used instead from the underlying supply dialog.  structural.text_zone restricts the match to the central dialog area so the Harbor sub-menu's normal Supply panel (which also contains those four words on the right side) doesn't false-fire.
detection: Supply + Water + Food + Material + Ammo + 0/326 + 0/325 + maximum capacity + load ratio
